topics.definition: DBMS na database-la irukkura data-va create, store, manage, retrieve panna use aagura software.
topics.explanation: Idhu users/applications-um database-um communicate panna oru interface-a work aagum.

topics.definition: Database na related data-va organized-a store pannura collection.
topics.explanation: Data-va systematic-a store pannradhunaala easy-a access, manage panna mudiyum.

topics.definition: RDBMS na data-va tables form-la store pannura Database Management System.
topics.explanation: Tables keys use panni relationships moolama connect aagum.

topics.definition: Table na data-va rows and columns-la organize panni store pannura structure.
topics.explanation: Rows records-a represent pannum; columns attributes-a represent pannum.

topics.definition: Tuple na relational table-la irukkura oru single row.
topics.explanation: Oru entity-oda complete record-a tuple represent pannum.

topics.definition: Attribute na oru entity-oda property or characteristic.
topics.explanation: Table-la attribute oru column-a represent aagum.

topics.definition: Primary Key na table-la each record-ai uniquely identify panna use aagura key.
topics.explanation: Idhula duplicate values-um NULL values-um irukka koodadhu.

topics.definition: Foreign Key na innoru table-oda key-ai reference pannura attribute.
topics.explanation: Idhu mainly rendu tables-kku relationship establish panna use aagum.

topics.definition: Candidate Key na oru record-ai uniquely identify panna mudiyura attribute or attributes set.
topics.explanation: Candidate keys-la oru key-ai Primary Key-a select pannuvanga.

topics.definition: Super Key na oru record-ai uniquely identify panna mudiyura attributes set.
topics.explanation: Unique identification-ku thevai illadha extra attributes-um idhula irukkalaam.

topics.definition: Alternate Key na Primary Key-a select pannappadaadha Candidate Key.
topics.explanation: Idhuvum records-ai uniquely identify panna mudiyum.

topics.definition: Composite Key na two or more attributes serndhu form aagura key.
topics.explanation: Multiple columns together use panni oru record-ai uniquely identify pannum.

topics.definition: Unique Key na oru column-la duplicate values varama ensure pannura constraint.
topics.explanation: Idhu table-la values unique-a irukka help pannum.

topics.definition: NULL na missing, unknown, illa available illaadha value-a represent pannum.
topics.explanation: NULL என்பது zero-um empty string-um illa; idhu different meaning கொண்டது.

topics.definition: Entity na real-world-la irukkura oru object; adhoda data database-la store pannuvom.
topics.explanation: Example: Student, Employee, Product, Department.

topics.definition: Entity Set na same type-oda multiple entities-oda collection.
topics.explanation: Example: College-la irukkura all students serndhu Student Entity Set.

topics.definition: ER Diagram na entities, attributes, relationships-ai graphical-a represent pannura diagram.
topics.explanation: Database structure-ai design panna idhu use aagum.

topics.definition: Relationship na two or more entities-kku between-la irukkura association.
topics.explanation: Example: Student oru Course-ai enroll pannirukkalaam.

topics.definition: Cardinality na oru relationship-la evlo entities participate panna mudiyum-nu define pannum.
topics.explanation: Common types 1:1, 1:N, and M:N.

topics.definition: Normalization na data redundancy-ai reduce panna database data-va organize pannura process.
topics.explanation: Data-va related tables-a divide panni consistency improve pannum.

topics.definition: 1NF na every attribute-um atomic or single value contain panna vendum.
topics.explanation: Oru cell-la multiple values illaama single value mattum irukkanum.

topics.definition: 2NF na table 1NF-la irukkanum and partial dependency irukka koodadhu.
topics.explanation: Every non-key attribute complete primary key-ai depend aaganum.

topics.definition: 3NF na table 2NF-la irukkanum and transitive dependency irukka koodadhu.
topics.explanation: Non-key attributes primary key-ai mattum depend aaganum.

topics.definition: BCNF na 3NF-oda stronger version.
topics.explanation: Relation-la irukkura every determinant-um candidate key-a irukkanum.

topics.definition: Denormalization na database-la intentional-a redundancy add pannura process.
topics.explanation: Main-a query performance improve panna use pannuvanga.

topics.definition: SQL na Structured Query Language; relational database-oda communicate panna use pannuvom.
topics.explanation: Data create, retrieve, modify, manage panna SQL commands use pannuvom.

topics.definition: DDL na Data Definition Language.
topics.explanation: Database structure define/modify panna CREATE, ALTER, DROP madhiri commands use pannum.

topics.definition: DML na Data Manipulation Language.
topics.explanation: Database data-va manipulate panna INSERT, UPDATE, DELETE madhiri commands use pannum.

topics.definition: DCL na Data Control Language.
topics.explanation: Database access permissions manage panna GRANT and REVOKE madhiri commands use pannum.

topics.definition: TCL na Transaction Control Language.
topics.explanation: Transactions manage panna COMMIT, ROLLBACK, SAVEPOINT madhiri commands use pannum.

topics.definition: SELECT na database-la irundhu data retrieve panna use aagura SQL command.
topics.explanation: Specific columns or conditions based-a records retrieve panna use pannalaam.

topics.definition: JOIN na multiple tables-la irukkura related data-va combine panna use aagura SQL operation.
topics.explanation: Related columns-ai base panni tables join pannuvom.

topics.definition: INNER JOIN na rendu tables-layum matching records-ai mattum return pannum.
topics.explanation: Match aagatha records result-la include aagathu.

topics.definition: LEFT JOIN na left table-oda all records-um, right table-oda matching records-um return pannum.
topics.explanation: Right table-la match illa na NULL values varum.

topics.definition: RIGHT JOIN na right table-oda all records-um, left table-oda matching records-um return pannum.
topics.explanation: Left table-la match illa na NULL values varum.

topics.definition: FULL OUTER JOIN na rendu tables-oda matching and non-matching records-ai return pannum.
topics.explanation: Match illaadha side-la NULL values varum.

topics.definition: View na SQL query base panni create pannura virtual table.
topics.explanation: Underlying tables-la irukkura data-va query result form-la display pannum.

topics.definition: Index na database-la data retrieval speed-ai improve panna use aagura structure.
topics.explanation: Search fast-a aagum; aana additional storage thevaipadum.

topics.definition: Transaction na database operations-oda oru logical unit.
topics.explanation: Transaction successful-a complete aaganum; illana appropriate-a rollback pannalaam.

topics.definition: ACID na Atomicity, Consistency, Isolation, Durability.
topics.explanation: Reliable and correct transaction processing-ai ensure panna indha four properties use aagum.

topics.definition: Atomicity na transaction complete-a execute aaganum illa complete-a execute aagama irukkanum.
topics.explanation: Oru operation fail aana entire transaction rollback panna mudiyum.

topics.definition: Consistency na transaction database-ai oru valid state-lendhu another valid state-ku kondu poganum.
topics.explanation: Database constraints transaction-ku munnum pinnum satisfy aaganum.

topics.definition: Isolation na concurrent transactions one another-ai improper-a affect pannama irukkum property.
topics.explanation: Oru transaction-oda intermediate changes-ai matra transactions direct-a affect panna mudiyadhu.

topics.definition: Durability na committed transaction changes permanent-a store aagum property.
topics.explanation: System failure vandhaalum committed changes retain aagum.

topics.definition: Concurrency Control na multiple transactions same time-la execute aagumbodhu manage pannura process.
topics.explanation: Conflicts prevent panni database consistency maintain pannum.

topics.definition: Deadlock na transactions one another hold pannura resources-kaga indefinitely wait pannura situation.
topics.explanation: Deadlock vandha transactions continue aaga mudiyama stuck aagum.

topics.definition: Stored Procedure na database-la store pannirukkura precompiled SQL statements-oda collection.
topics.explanation: Specific operation-ai repeated-a execute panna use pannalaam.

topics.definition: Trigger na specific database event nadakkumbodhu automatically execute aagura database operation.
topics.explanation: INSERT, UPDATE, DELETE madhiri events-ku trigger activate aagalaam.

topics.definition: Cursor na query result-la rows-ai one by one process panna use aagura database mechanism.
topics.explanation: Individual rows sequential-a process panna useful-a irukkum.

topics.definition: Referential Integrity na tables-kku between irukkura relationships valid-a maintain pannura rule.
topics.explanation: Foreign Key value referenced table-la valid existing record-ai reference panna vendum.
